pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: Gunner, you should be downright embarrassed that your beloved France couldn't even muster a single goal against Devin's Spain—0-2, bub! Let me tell you something, "Bubba G," you strut around like you've got this in the bag, but the only bag you've got is full of hot air! Devin, yeah, you're at the top right now with 92 points, but don't start booking your victory parade yet. You picked Bosnia, and in my book, that says you've got a weakness, a chink in the armor, a moment of ill-preparation that will cost you dearly. Gayden, "The Backpass Assassin," how could you possibly allow yourself to languish in third place at 52 points with England at the helm? Look at me! This sport is about risk and courage, and you picking Jordan? It's like you threw a dart blindfolded and hoped for magic! And Zach—oh, "Mustard Boy," you're sitting at fourth with a paltry 43 points, and you've got Brazil on your roster. It's like owning a Ferrari and driving it like a minivan. Rafe, "The Noisemaker," when you drafted three teams that didn't even qualify, you set a new low in the annals of fantasy sport. You're at 29 points; the only thing you're leading is a youth soccer team to the nearest ice cream truck. This battle is far from over, gentlemen, but mark my words, if you don't wise up, you'll find yourself further humiliated faster than you can say "1994 World Cup glory days."
